description: Domains to send purchase offers to - sorted by acquisition value

targets.acquisition_channel: Afternic BIN/offer via ns1.afternic.com landing page
targets.notes: Afternic NS = actively listed for sale. Check Afternic.com for listed price. May have BuyItNow price. Highest priority offer target.

targets.acquisition_channel: Afternic BIN/offer. Also has clientRenewProhibited - may drop Jul 17 if not sold
targets.notes: DUAL STRATEGY: Send offer through Afternic AND place backorder. clientRenewProhibited + Afternic = owner listed for sale and will let drop if no buyer. 24 year old domain.

targets.acquisition_channel: NameFind premium listing. Also has clientRenewProhibited - may drop Jul 20 if not sold
targets.notes: DUAL STRATEGY: Check NameFind.com for listed price AND place backorder. 21 year old domain. clientRenewProhibited.

targets.acquisition_channel: DomainMarket.com - NS literally says 'domain-is-4-sale'. Visit domainmarket.com/domain/devframework.com
targets.notes: Explicitly for sale at DomainMarket.com. Full for-sale landing page active (101KB). Check listed price - DomainMarket usually lists fixed prices.

targets.acquisition_channel: BrandBucket.com - redirects to brandbucket.com/names/devaide. Buy directly on platform.
targets.notes: Listed on BrandBucket branded domain marketplace. BrandBucket typically lists at $2K-$10K. Check their price and buy if within budget.

targets.acquisition_channel: Check Dynadot marketplace for listing. Send offer via Dynadot WHOIS contact.
targets.notes: HIGHEST DR target (42.5) in offer category. Dynadot parking page (341 bytes). Owner actively managing (updated Jan 2026). Premium keyword domain - may command premium price.

targets.acquisition_channel: Contact via Easyspace registrar. IIS server with stale 2020 content. Owner may not realize domain's AI-niche value.
targets.notes: 26 year old domain. Last content update March 2020. Not updated since May 2024. Owner may have forgotten about it. Low-ball offer may work.

targets.acquisition_channel: Check Sav.com marketplace. Spaceship parking page active. Send offer via Sav.com.
targets.notes: Sav.com registrar with Spaceship parking. Updated yesterday - actively managed. 8 year old .io domain.

targets.acquisition_channel: Check NameBright marketplace. Site returns 404 = abandoned. Send offer through NameBright.
targets.notes: NameBright DNS with 404 error. 13 year old domain. Owner auto-renewed but may accept reasonable offer.

targets.acquisition_channel: Send offer via eNom/PowWeb WHOIS contact. Minimal website (132 bytes).
targets.notes: 22 year old domain. PowWeb hosting with tiny page. eNom registrar. Owner holding with minimal effort.

targets.acquisition_channel: Contact via PDR registrar. GoDaddy DomainControl parking NS. Tiny static page from 2021.
targets.notes: 26 year old domain. DR 22.5. DomainControl parking through PDR registrar. Owner may be open to offer.

targets.acquisition_channel: clientRenewProhibited + Cloudflare active. Check GoDaddy aftermarket for listing. Also place backorder.
targets.notes: DUAL STRATEGY: 18 year old domain with active Cloudflare site. clientRenewProhibited = may be listed on GoDaddy aftermarket. HSTS headers suggest recently active site.

targets.acquisition_channel: clientRenewProhibited + WordPress redirect. Check GoDaddy aftermarket. Also place backorder.
targets.notes: DUAL STRATEGY: 24 year old domain. WordPress site with redirect. clientRenewProhibited.

targets.acquisition_channel: Framer site returning 404. Contact via NameCheap. Former geospatial AI company may sell.
targets.notes: Premium .ai domain. Framer site taken down (404). DR 20. Owner may be winding down and open to offers.

targets.acquisition_channel: Dundas.com NS = may be corporate held. Contact via Porkbun.
targets.notes: 27 year old domain. Dundas NS suggests corporate ownership. No website. May be difficult to acquire.

targets.acquisition_channel: Moniker = domain investor registrar. Moniker DNS parking. Contact through Moniker.
targets.notes: 24 year old finance keyword domain. Domain investor likely wants premium price. Moniker parking = actively monetizing.

targets.acquisition_channel: GoDaddy PDNS = Premium DNS parking. Check GoDaddy aftermarket for listed price.
targets.notes: 28 year old finance domain. Premium GoDaddy parking. Recently renewed. Owner is actively maintaining.
